supersedes: Earlier draft used the older 18-call word, retained the MOVE, applied an obsolete restricted scalar list as a universal ban, and used a flat per-route physical charge.

current_source.call_count_note: Current #7481 signed caller per root instruction; the compressed native word itself is one invocation.

generic_fixed_rational_service.role: Fixed-rational exact carry/remainder service and 2^20 per padded component-bit service reserve; fixed rational denominators are not restricted to {2,3,5} when exact division succeeds.

generic_route_record_bound.role: Symbolic elementary-record bound 4(n+1)^2 per n-axis binary monomial and per-record cost C_move*V*((f*log(p))^tau+1), plus setup; no flat physical-record constant.

legacy_restricted_scalar_validator.role: Older selected #7000 word grammar provenance only. Its {2,3,5}-smooth scalar check is not the general exact fixed-rational service condition used here.

local_validation.role: Normal and optimized runs; identical receipts.

gaussian_phase_control.role: Exact Clifford convention for C_v=(1+i)I/2+(1-i)X/2 used only by the nonidentity synthetic chart control.
